name: moru
description: Carry multi-step work through source discovery, routing, execution, verification, and one consolidated result.

interface.longDescription: Moru coordinates explicitly requested multi-step work across project sources, specialist skills, tools, connected services, and optional subagents. It preserves scope and authorization, verifies real outcomes, and returns one consolidated result.
defaultPrompt: Use $moru to complete this request and verify the result.
Use $moru to implement this change and run the relevant checks.
Use $moru to review this work without modifying it.
